purpose: Compare fixed SMA20/60 with cash and fixed-size buy-and-hold under a predetermined commission grid
strategy: SMA20/60 long only, existing engine unchanged
cash_reference: USD cash, zero interest, no fills
buy_hold_reference: Buy the fixed quantity at ASK at the first observed open after 61 completed UTC sessions (zero-based session index 61). Hold to the final observed BID mark, no forced sale and no hypothetical final exit fee.
warmup_rule: 61 completed sessions make the first SMA crossover decision possible; the earliest possible SMA execution and the reference entry are session index 61. Require at least 62 sessions for comparison.
spread: Included through ASK purchases and BID sales/marks in every scenario, including zero commission
quantity_rule: Fixed EUR units, no reinvestment or leverage; different time in market is retained and disclosed
quality_rule: Existing blocks unchanged; no missing-price filling or new date cuts
